title: Campfire cover: an old folk tune, our own bird verses
storyboard: Film: 6–10 campers singing round a campfire with one guitar; wide + 2 close-ups, 3 takes

scenes.headline: Campfire cover: an old folk tune, brand-new bird verses
Kids remember facts they sing.
scenes.body: Kingfishers dive for fish. Nesting hornbill mums are walled into tree holes. Peacocks display to peahens.

caption:
A camp-night classic with new words.

In most hornbill species the nest hole is closed with mud while the female is inside, leaving a small opening through which the male passes food.

Source: Britannica.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Medium risk (composition rights): our version uses only a public-domain traditional melody with original lyrics, no copyrighted song or lyrics on screen; every lyric is a sourced fact.
